verdict.rationale: The GitHub Mobile evidence covers triage, PR review, merging and managing Copilot agent tasks, but always one item at a time. Nothing documents selecting or acting on many items at once. The GitHub CLI, REST/GraphQL APIs and Actions are separate platform tools or developer building blocks, not GitHub Mobile features, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
